Rajeev — thanks for the clear ask. Short answers first: yes, default tenant debug/session logs are configured for 14-day TTL in the hosted pilot environment; yes, we support ad-hoc tenant-level purge requests; and we can produce a time-stamped evidence bundle for SOC 2 that includes operation logs and deletion receipts.

What follows is a proposal for deliverables and an estimated timeline. I copied Marissa and Ben to scope export/artifact pieces.

Proposed deliverables:
- Purge confirmation: API-triggered purge receipt (JSON/CSV) with tenant id, requestor id, timestamp, and deleted object counts.
- Audit export: sequence of operation logs for the tenant covering the retention window, with hashes and a signing header.
- Attestation doc: Redwood engineer statement (signed) summarizing the purge runbook executed.

Estimated timeline (one-off request):
- Evidence checklist & export spec: 2 business days (attached).
- Data extraction & proof package: 3-5 business days after sign-off (depends on volume and whether legal hold applies).
- Attestation & delivery: 1 business day after extraction.

Please confirm whether Lyracle requires the evidence to include keystore rotation metadata and/or CAIQ-specific artifacts (we can include CAIQ/SIG crosswalk items if needed, but that adds 1-2 days).

I attached a short retention proposal PDF and an SOC 2 evidence checklist to accelerate sign-off.

Hi Rajeev / Neha — looping in the evidence delivery owners and legal-hold process.

Behavior on legal holds: Redwood will stop any scheduled deletion/extraction for a tenant the moment a legal hold flag is raised. We record the hold event in our operations log (hold_event_id, actor, timestamp) and notify the requestor and the evidence team. For an in-flight extraction, we will snapshot the current extraction state, halt deletion steps, and provide the partial artifact plus the hold_event record. That will be documented in the attestation.

SLA for evidence delivery (pilot, one-off):
- Checklist sign-off to delivery: 5 business days if no legal hold and data < 200GB.
- If legal hold is invoked during extraction: we pause deletion and provide partial extraction within 2 business days, final delivery timeline depends on hold resolution.

Operational steps we will take for your request:
1) Confirm tenant id and requestor identity (Rajeev, please confirm preferred requestor email).
2) Open an evidence job (EJ-########) and share a HubSpot + Drive link for the package.
3) Run extraction in read-only mode, produce signed receipts for deletion operations, and generate attestation.
4) Deliver package and post-delivery follow-up to confirm acceptance.

Attachments below are the checklist and the draft extraction job template. Ben, Priya — can you confirm the extraction runbook ETA for a typical 50–150GB tenant?

Marissa
Trust Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
